rationale: Base 682714a7. AD-322 and epic #880 step S3. The new module archkeel.ir.coverage owns the completeness of an observation and the scan-root coverage of a source. It joins the architecture owner in contracts/ir.json (exact_modules and public) and the public list of the ir component in the root contract. The function parse_numeric_evidence_excerpt moves into archkeel.ir.source_proofs. It joins the public list of facts-codec, the public list of ir, and the through list of the analyzer requirement on ir, because the Python collector now calls the one parser instead of keeping a copy. No budget, rule, component, other requires entry or Any permission changes. The baseline does not change: calls_unresolved stays 972.
